selection: First five eligible paragraphs per pinned page, before detector runs; 20-260 whitespace words, 120-2200 characters; quotation-rich paragraphs additionally mention the Prophet or Messenger. Original extracted text is retained.

reuse.attribution: Page title, permanent revision URL and history URL identify Wikimedia contributors; the Wikisource original work is by Ibn Rajab al-Hanbali (died 1393).
reuse.changes: Plain text extracted from HTML paragraph elements; reference superscripts and HTML tags removed; br becomes LF; no matching normalization or spelling repair. Dataset annotations are separate, provisional additions.
reuse.scope: Natural-source snapshots/excerpts and their attribution retain their source terms; the repository MIT code license does not replace them. No images or other media are collected.
